services.desc: Please fill out the form at the bottom of this page or send inquires to: info@tenderloinmuseum.org The Tenderloin Museum offers a unique, elegant space for a variety of different events, such as film screenings, lectures, presentations, workshops, company parties or community meetings. Located just a 5-minute walk from Union Square shopping and Civic Center BART, our space was originally part of the famous Cadillac Hotel, which became the first non-profit SRO west of the Mississippi and has played a major role in the Tenderloin's history.
